benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Coverage for damage to or theft of your cell phone when you pay your monthly wireless bill with this card.
benefits.terms: Coverage begins the calendar month after paying your wireless bill with the card. Supplemental to any other insurance; subject to a deductible per claim.

benefits.name: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Accidental death and dismemberment coverage up to $250,000 when the entire common carrier fare is purchased with this card.

benefits.name: Visa Signature Concierge
benefits.description: Complimentary 24/7 concierge service for travel, dining, and event bookings, available on accounts with a credit line of $5,000 or more (Visa Signature tier).
benefits.terms: Only available on accounts that qualify for Visa Signature (credit line $5,000+); accounts below that line get Visa Traditional benefits instead.

earningRates.terms: 2% cash back requires Honors Advantage eligibility: being the primary owner of both this card and a PenFed checking account, and maintaining either a $500+ daily balance or $500+/month in direct deposits (or qualifying active/veteran military status). Without Honors Advantage, the rate is 1.5%.
Base rate for cardholders who do not qualify for PenFed Honors Advantage. No category restrictions, no caps.
